content.text: Reading the export controller to find the entry point and the sink it reaches.

Chain established: POST /api/export (no [Authorize] on the action or the controller) -> request.Filter interpolated into a command string -> Process.Start via /bin/sh -c. That is command execution as the service account, reachable unauthenticated, so it is Critical and the verdict is BLOCK. Veto items: critical-finding-unmitigated and unauthenticated-privileged-path. Posting the GIGACLAW-VERDICT comment with inputDigest over src/Api/ExportController.cs and that file as the first path evidence entry, and writing the report to doc/security/audits/ticket-512.md. I am not fixing the code; remediation is a programmer ticket.
